definitions.explanation: An informal, emphatic word meaning extremely cheap or at a bargain price. Formed from {爆|ばく} (explosive) + {安|やす} (cheap), suggesting prices so low they are shocking.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{爆安|ばくやす}だ。
{爆安|ばくやす}⟦セール→セール：07780_seeru⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a lot of clothes at the blowout sale.

examples.japanese: ⟦ネット→ネット：05279_netto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{爆安|ばくやす}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{航空券|こうくうけん}→航空券：19426_koukuuken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つけた→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{予約|よやく}した→予約する：22989_yoyakusuru⟧。
examples.english: I found insanely cheap plane tickets online, so I booked them right away.

notes:
USAGE:
An informal, colloquial word commonly used in advertising, online shopping, and casual conversation. Part of the {爆|ばく}〜 pattern where {爆|ばく} intensifies the following word.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {爆安|ばくやす}⟦セール→セール：07780_seeru⟧ (blowout sale)
- {爆安|ばくやす}⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧ (rock-bottom price)
- {爆安|ばくやす}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧ (to buy dirt cheap)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{激安|げきやす}→激安：13373_gekiyasu⟧: very cheap — similar meaning but slightly less emphatic
- ⟦{格安|かくやす}→格安：15125_kakuyasu⟧: bargain-priced — more neutral and widely used
